newsitem.title: GERMANY: German medium "settled" heavenly debt - police.
newsitem.headline: German medium "settled" heavenly debt - police.

text.p: German police said on Tuesday they had arrested a man posing as a spiritual medium who was paid 15,000 marks ($10,000) by a woman to pay off gambling debts he said her dead husband had contracted in heaven.
Police detained the 23-year-old who they named only as Timor in a sting operation last week and a judge later issued an arrest warrant.
They said Timor had placed advertisments in newspapers across Germany and were not ruling out the possibility he had swindled other people who had not yet come forward.
The 85-year-old woman had asked Timor to make contact with her dead husband.
Timor also demanded 100,000 marks on behalf of her husband for the purchase of a plot of land "in heaven" and police detained him as the money was handed over in a hotel in Hanover. police said.
